Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! It is now a 2-match T20I series as the first game ended in a no result. The second match takes place on the 5th of November at 1910 local (0810 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

So it has been a frustrating day for the cricketing fans! Right from the start we have had rain. First the heavens opened up just after the toss but that cleared quickly and we started on time. Australia though dominated throughout. They were on top before the first rain break and remained on top even after resumption. Finch, their skipper, came out all guns blazing, took the attack to the opposition bowlers and smashed them all around the park. In no time the Australians got to 41 and had it not been for the rain, it would have probably been a stroll in the park for the hosts.

So the inevitable has happened! The GAME HAS BEEN CALLED OFF! Pakistan will breathe a huge sigh of relief as one would probably say they got away with one here. It was Australia's game to lose as they needed only 78 in 71 balls.
Update 1748 local (0648 GMT) - Still no news from the centre as the rain refuses to relent. The time is running out as the chances are bleak of the game resuming anytime soon.

Update 1718 local (0618 GMT) - A pat on the back for me! I just wrote that rain is around the corner and here it comes. The players make their way back in. We are still 11 balls away from this game having a result.
Good length and on off, Finch guides it past point and takes two.

Length and on off, Finch pushes this length ball back to the bowler who fails to field it in his follow through. The batsmen take a single off the misfield there. Massive over for Australia as they take 26 off Mohammad Irfan's over.

FOUR! Good effort in the field by Wahab Riaz. Irfan dishes out another fuller one outside off, Finch this time drives him through the line past mid off. Wahab gives the chase and manages to stop it just near the ropes as he went over it. But not to his liking to push the ball away  further from the ropes he fails to get himself out from the other side of the boundary. The umpires take it upstairs and the replays are conclusive that his hands are in contact with the ball. So a boundary earned for Finch and Aussies.
It has gotten dark out there! Rain might just be around the corner now.
Finally a dot. This time Finch pushes this length ball to mid off.
FREE HIT! Finch has taken a toll here on Irfan. Irfan goes short and Finch stands back and pulls it handsomely over the square leg fence this time for another biggie. Finch is toying here.
Free Hit coming up!

NO BALL! Irfan is nervous on his comeback. This time in search of some swing he goes extra mile and oversteps. Irfan goes full and outside off, Finch lofts it cleanly over the covers and the ball races away to the extra cover fence in a flash.

FOUR! That is pure timing. Finch this time just places the ball in the gap. Irfan goes full and on the pads, Finch flicks it with poise through the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary. The skipper is enjoying it.
SIX! WHACK! Finch is not going to hold himself back. Irfan goes slightly short and Aaron just pulls him with power and disdain over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
One more delivery on middle, once again no room given to the batsman. Finch again keeps it out. A good over by Amir after going for a boundary early on.
Good line! Nice and tight, giving the batter no room no play with. Finch keeps it out.
Warner comes down the track and Amir bowls it on the body, giving the batter no room to work with. Warner looks to flick but misses. It hits the pads and rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken.
Good single! This is on middle, Finch taps it towards cover and takes one.
FOUR! That is some shot by Aaron Finch. Stand and deliver stuff! This is shorter and around off, Finch stands tall and punches it through cover-point. Boundary. Second for Finch.
On the shorter side around off, Warner pulls it through square leg and takes one.
Mohammad Amir to start from the other end.

Close! Good length and on off, Finch pushes it to mid off and initially takes off. Warner does so too but is sent back. He turns and dives to get in. Wasim picks the ball up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Replays show that Warner would have been in. End of an action-packed over.
FOUR! Up and over! Another poor ball and this is put away. Short and outside off, Finch slaps it over point and the ball races away to the fence.
Another full toss and another miss! This one is outside off, Finch too is surprised as he fails to put bat on ball. Not sure if Irfan is nervous on his return or the ball is slipping.
Good length and around off, Finch pushes it to mid off.
Good length and on off, Warner works it towards mid-wicket for one. Off the mark are the Aussies.
Well, that must have slipped out! A high full toss to begin with. Not high enough to be adjudged a no ball but still high. Warner is also surprised by it. He defends it out.

We are back for the chase. The Pakistan players are out in the middle. Out come the two Australian openers, skipper Aaron Finch and dashing David Warner. Mohammad Irfan to start the proceedings with the new ball.
